title: Design Engineer
must_have: 3+ years of experience in mechanical design
text:
Design Engineer
Sahyadri Auto Components | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a design engineer to join our mechanical design team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Finite Element Analysis
- Thermodynamics
- CNC Machining
- Six Sigma
- SolidWorks
- 3+ years of experience in mechanical design

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- PLC Programming
- Manufacturing Processes
- 3D Printing
- GD&T

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive heat-exchanger redesign with measurable outcomes.
- Drive vendor tooling programme with measurable outcomes.
- Drive assembly-line layout revamp with measurable outcomes.
